runs.text: Turkey, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Istanbul is stolen land. Until fourteen fifty three, it was Constantinople. Give it back to the Byzantines! And before them? Greeks called it Byzantium. Finding two: occupation. Since nineteen seventy four, Turkish troops have held northern Cyprus. Only Turkey recognizes it. Finding three: settlers. Settlers from Turkey moved in, and the Council of Europe wrote a whole report on them. Finding four: from nineteen eighty three to nineteen ninety one, publishing in Kurdish was banned by law. Finding five: every November, Americans eat a turkey. Genocide. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Turkey isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. Same test, from the top.
